high_level_description: The image is a collage consisting of two separate sections, each with its own set of photographs and accompanying text. Top Section: The text at the top reads: "When my little sister was 5 she drew that first picture in art class and gave it to me, now she's 12 and sends me pictures like this" followed by two emojis, one heart-eyed and one sad. Below the text, there are three photographs: The first photograph on the left shows a simple drawing of a person riding a bicycle, drawn on a piece of paper.
